state.empty.kitchen.title: Rasoi khaali hai
state.empty.kitchen.body: Bataiye kya hai — "do kilo aloo, ek dozen ande"
state.offline.title: Aap offline hain

mic.label: Cookmate se baat karo
onb.welcome.title: Aaj kya banega, decided.
onb.welcome.body: Batao kitchen mein kya hai aur ghar mein kaun khaata hai. Cookmate batayega kya banana hai, aur voice se, aapki bhasha mein, step by step saath chalega.
onb.welcome.error: Start nahi ho paya. Internet check karke dobara try karo.
onb.language.title: Apni bhasha chuniye
onb.members.title: Ghar mein kaun khaata hai?
onb.members.body: Jinke liye aap khana banate ho, unhe add karo. 6 log tak. Baad mein badal sakte ho.
onb.members.name: Naam
onb.spice.title: Kitna teekha pasand hai?
onb.spice.body: Bachchon ke liye halka rakhenge. Aapke feedback se Cookmate seekhta rahega.
onb.diet.title: Ghar mein kya khaate ho?
onb.diet.body: Abhi sab par lagega. Har person ke liye You tab mein badal sakte ho.
onb.consent.title: Aapki kitchen, aapki marzi
onb.consent.body: Jo theek lage wahi on karo. Kabhi bhi badal sakte ho.
consent.voice_processing.title: Voice se cooking
consent.voice_processing.body: Aapki awaaz ko text mein badla jaata hai taaki Cookmate samajh sake. Recording rakhi nahi jaati.
consent.memory.title: Jo seekhe, yaad rakhe
consent.memory.body: Cookmate aapke feedback se taste yaad rakhega, jaise "agli baar lahsun zyada". Har memory aap dekh aur hata sakte ho.
consent.analytics.title: Cookmate ko better banao
consent.analytics.body: Sirf usage ki ginti. Aap kya bolte ya banate ho, woh kabhi nahi.
onb.consent.creating: Aapki kitchen ready ho rahi hai…
onb.error.create: Kitchen setup nahi ho payi. Aapki choices saved hain; dobara try karo.
kitchen.addPlaceholder: Jaise bolte ho waise likho: "2 kilo aloo, ek dozen ande, thoda atta"
kitchen.confirmBody: Jo galat hai theek karo, phir add karo.
kitchen.parseEmpty: Koi item nahi mila. Aise likho: "2 kilo aloo".
kitchen.addError: Add nahi ho paya. Aapki list yahin hai; dobara try karo.
item.notFound: Yeh item ab kitchen mein nahi hai.
home.nothingFits.title: Abhi isse match karta kuch nahi
home.nothingFits.body: Kam filter lagao, ya batao rasoi mein kya hai.
home.focusNone: Abhi kisi dish mein {item} nahi hai; baaki mein se ye best hain
recipe.draft: Draft: humari rasoi ne abhi test nahi kiya
recipe.assumed: Aamtaur pe rasoi mein hota hai
search.title: Recipe dhoondho
search.hint: Kisi bhi bhasha mein dish ya saamaan likho.
search.none: "{q}" se match karti koi dish abhi nahi
search.noneBody: Koi aur naam ya uska saamaan likh ke dekho.
adapt.title: Apne tareeke se
adapt.body: Batao kya badalna hai. Test kiye niyam pehle, aur safety wale steps kabhi nahi badalte.
adapt.unresolved: Yahan {items} ki jagah rasoi mein kuch nahi hai. List mein daalein?
adapt.noChange: Kam se kam ek badlaav chuno
quick.cta: Quick start: kal kya banaya tha?
quick.ctaBody: Usse andaaza lagaunga ki rasoi mein kya hai.
quick.title: Kal kya banaya tha?
quick.body: Dish chuno. Uski cheezein andaaze se jodunga, jab tak aap haan na kaho "Abhi bhi hai?" likha rahega.
quick.none: {dish}: sab kuch pehle se rasoi mein hai
quick.addedBody: Rasoi mein confirm karne tak ye suggestions mein nahi gine jayenge.
cook.resume.title: {dish} abhi ban rahi hai?
cook.resume.step: Aap {total} mein se step {n} par the.
cook.notFound: Yeh cooking session available nahi hai.
cook.notSynced: Abhi aapki jagah save nahi ho paayi. Pakate rahein; is phone par sab safe hai.
cook.timer.label: Step {n}
cook.timer.silent: Notifications band hain, isliye timer tabhi bajenge jab Cookmate khula ho.
cook.whistle.title: Seetiyan ginein
finish.title: {dish} taiyaar hai!
finish.body: Teen chhoti baatein. Jo chahein skip kar dein.
finish.deduct: Yeh cheezein kitchen se ghata dein?
finish.deductBody: Quantity badal sakte hain, ya koi line band kar dein.
finish.deductNone: Aapki kitchen list se kuch use nahi hua.
finish.leftoversBody: Yeh fridge list mein jud jaayega, taaki hum yaad dila sakein.
finish.failed: Yeh save nahi ho paaya. Dobara try karein, ya skip kar dein.
